summary: Backend-only publish-prep verification through the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ingress. 30 pytest tests (28 executed, 2 LLM-spend tests skipped by design): 27 passed, 1 failed. KEY RESULT: POST /api/stories now returns HTTP 402 with content-type application/json and the exact body {"detail":"AI credit budget exceeded. Please top up your Emergent LLM key balance."} — the JSON arrives INTACT through the ingress (no HTML 502 page), verified for both en and hi payloads and via raw curl. Consider also matching provider status codes (402/429) from the integration exception.
